  str      zen strings len=11  storage=whatever it points at   freed=by that owner
  [u8]     zen strings len=11  storage=whatever it points at   freed=by that owner

-- 2. borrow vs copy --
  BORROW  trim_view -> [u8] len=19, allocated 0 bytes (aims into the literal)
  COPY    substr    -> str  len=19, allocated 20 bytes (fresh block, `a` owns it)
  ALIAS   stored 'S' through a [u8] window; its source now reads: Shared bytes
  FREED   both substr blocks released; the two literals are never freed
